people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jehu
people.line: Son of Jehoshaphat, king of Israel, destroyed Ahab's dynasty.

people.name: Jeroboam
people.line: First king of the northern kingdom of Israel.

people.name: Nebat
people.line: Father of Jeroboam, the first king of Israel.

translations.web: However, Jehu didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin, the golden calves that were in Bethel and that were in Dan.
translations.bsb: but he did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit—the worship of the golden calves at Bethel and Dan.
translations.kjv: Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, Jehu departed not from after them, to wit, the golden calves that were in Bethel, and that were in Dan.
translations.asv: Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, wherewith he made Israel to sin, Jehu departed not from after them, to wit, the golden calves that were in Beth-el, and that were in Dan.
